visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a male chef in a white professional uniform standing behind a kitchen counter. He holds chopsticks and eats a green bean with a satisfied facial expression, nodding and gesturing with a thumbs up. A plate of cooked green beans and a jar of chili paste sit on the counter. The lighting is bright and studio-focused, with a textured grey brick wall in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a black frying pan on a wooden table. A pair of hands pours oil from a bottle and then adds a large portion of long, green beans. The beans are tossed with wooden chopsticks as they begin to blister and turn a vibrant green with charred yellow-gold spots. (3) Minced meat is added to the pan and broken up with chopsticks. Then, small bowls of minced garlic, ginger, and other aromatics are poured into the sizzling meat mixture. The chef continues to stir-fry the ingredients until the meat is browned and the aromatics are well-distributed. (4) The previously fried beans are returned to the pan. A jar of 'Bullhead' spicy chili paste is featured in a macro close-up, and a large spoonful is added directly onto the beans. The sauce is stirred, coating everything in a glossy, red-tinted oil. Close-ups show the granular texture of the sauce ingredients. (5) Liquid seasoning and water are added to the pan, causing a slight steam. Finally, chopped green onions and red chili flakes are sprinkled on top. The finished dish is plated onto a grey triangular plate. The chef reappears at the end, gesturing excitedly toward the food while the product jar remains visible on the counter.
